active_kst_linear_motion_source_audit.blocking_behavior: The MATLAB client waits for a server acknowledgment after the blocking Sunrise lin() move; an outer MATLAB timer is not a certified interrupt.

These raw values are not a complete robot-payload mass or CoM estimate because they exclude the sensor body/robot-side hardware and include bias, cable load, and an unqualified measurement origin.

Configure and deploy matching Sunrise LoadData instead of MASS=0 / CoM=[0,0,0], then record the deployed project/source hash.
Add and deploy an explicit reviewed Cartesian acceleration bound for KST relative WORLD lin() motion; record the applied default/jerk behavior.

closure_rule: motion_qualified may become true only after every blocker has evidence and an independent static review confirms that the live Sunrise project matches this record. Historical successful motion is connectivity evidence, not payload or acceleration qualification.
